message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [labeled, synchronize]

jobs:
  build-preview:
    if: contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'deploy-preview')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency: ci-build-deploy-${{ github.ref }}
    permissions:
      contents: read

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          allow-unsafe-pr-checkout: true

      - name: Attempt merge with offline branch
        id: merge
        run: |

          git config user.name "deploy-ci"
          git config user.email "deploy-ci@users.noreply.github.com"
          git fetch origin offline-mode:offline-mode
          git checkout offline-mode

          if git merge --no-commit --no-ff ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}; then
            exit 0
          else
            git merge --abort
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: "22"

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6

      - name: Restore pnpm store
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: ~/.local/share/pnpm/store
          key: pnpm-store-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            pnpm-store-${{ runner.os }}-"
  "rationale": "The workflow runs `pnpm install --filter client --filter shared --filter server` on every pull request but does not cache the pnpm dependency store, only a build-output atlas cache. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (dependency_cache) is supported by observational evidence reporting modest VM-time reduction for caching dependency downloads, with preconditions met: repeated dependency fetching is measurable and a lockfile (pnpm-lock.yaml) exists for cache input keying. Adding a pnpm store cache before installation preserves all build and test steps, requires no new permissions, secrets, or network access, and is a minimal workflow-scoped change.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
